title: GlobalHealth
description: All players share one global health bar. Damage one, damage all. Heal one, heal all. If one player dies, everyone dies. Perfect for challenges, hardcore modes, and teamwork-focused gameplay as well as creating content and events.
body:
# ❤️ SharedHealth

**One health bar. One life. One mistake and everyone pays.**

SharedHealth connects every player on the server into a single global health pool. Damage, healing, death, and everything is shared in real time. Survival is no longer individual. The entire server lives or dies together

---

![Shared Health Bar](https://media1.tenor.com/m/4kyhxhMqsBQAAAAd/minecraft-damage.gif)

---

## ⚙️ Core Mechanics

- ❤️ **Global Health Pool** - All players share the exact same health
- ⚔️ **Shared Damage** - Hurt one player, hurt everyone
- ✨ **Shared Healing** - Heal one player, heal everyone
- ☠️ **Linked Death** - If one player dies, the entire server dies instantly
- 🔄 **Join Sync** - New players automatically match the current global health
- 🔁 **Respawn Sync** - Respawning players rejoin with shared health

---

## 🎮 Gameplay Experience

SharedHealth completely transforms survival:

- Forces real teamwork and coordination  
- One careless move can wipe the entire server  
- Creates intense, high-stakes gameplay  
- Perfect for:
  - Hardcore servers
  - Challenge events
  - SMP 
  - Team-based survival
  - Content creation / viral challenges

---

## 🚀 Use Cases

- "One Life Server" challenge  
- Hardcore but worse mode  
- Team survival experiments 
- Trolling
- YouTube challenge content  
- Stream events  

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar`
2. Place it into your `/plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Done, all players now share one life

No config nor setup needed.

---
